question: Can the E00 saved recurrence be independently regenerated within the declared absolute error?

method.action: Deterministic synthetic recurrence only; no physical action or spacetime claim

hypotheses.prediction: Observed and independently regenerated values agree within the declared tolerance.
At least one value differs by more than the declared tolerance.

controls.purpose: Detect output corruption or a changed recurrence
controls.method: Regenerate expected values independently from the saved configuration.

criteria.pass_if: all 24 saved samples and maximum error <= 1e-14
criteria.fail_if: complete saved sequence has maximum error > 1e-14
criteria.unresolved_if: sequence incomplete, unverified, or comparison unavailable

visualization_plan.question: Does the saved trace follow the independent recurrence over all 24 steps?
visualization_plan.representation: line overlay with numerical residual summary

competing_signatures.disagreement: separated traces or residual over tolerance

visualization_plan.uncertainty: display the maximum absolute error against the locked tolerance
transformations: no smoothing; plot saved observed and expected columns

prohibited_inferences: E00 is a technical fixture; it cannot establish physical propagation or geometry.
